claims: Nicholas Brendon died in his sleep at age 54, according to a statement from his family.
Nicholas Brendon's family stated he passed away of natural causes.
Nicholas Brendon had been open about suffering a heart attack in recent years.
Nicholas Brendon had been battling paralyzing spinal issues (cauda equina syndrome) in recent years.
Nicholas Brendon had been battling substance addiction in recent years.
Nicholas Brendon was best known for playing Xander Harris on Buffy the Vampire Slayer from 1997 to 2003
